facts.value: A community always occupies a territorial area.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: The strong bond of solidarity that we find among the members of a community is derived from the condition of locality (living in a definite geographic area).
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: The local bond has been weakened in the modern world by the extending facilities of communication.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: The extension of communication itself is responsible for the expansion of communities far and wide.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Locality is not enough to create a community; it needs a feeling of belonging together (we-feeling).
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: There must be a common living with its awareness of sharing a way of life as well as the common earth.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy
